data.name: Marab
data.gender_notes: Marab is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'r-b-b', meaning 'to be high, exalted, or noble'. In Islamic tradition, it symbolizes the status of Allah (swt) and the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) as the highest and most exalted beings. The name Marab carries the meaning “The Exalted One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Marab usually hope their child will grow to embody the exalted one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies reverence and devotion to Allah.
data.etymology: Marab belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Exalted One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Marab total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
